name: google-workspace-mcp
description: Reads Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets with memory-only OAuth credentials. Enter JSON with email, client_id, client_secret and refresh_token through Ave's secret prompt. Interactive login is disabled. Local download and full-message export tools require an explicit local-write opt-in. Requires Node.js 24+ and uv (or AVE_CONNECTOR_UV); the source wheel and dependencies are hash-locked.
